item.title: Gabriella’s Modern Italian 1 Year Anniversary Celebration
item.description: Miami, FL- March 5, 2026 - Gabriella’s Modern Italian, the Delray Beach dining destination by restaurateur Frank Brusco, celebrated its first anniversary with a lively evening marking one year since its March 2025 debut. Designed by Celano Design Studio and built by IBO Construction Group, the restaurant has become known for modern takes on Italian classics like Spicy Rigatoni, Smoked Burrata, and tableside Tiramisu, alongside signature cocktails such as the Amalfi Spritz and Ciao Bella. item.title: WRE News: Dolphins Release Tua Tagovailoa, Ending Six Year Era in Miami
item.description: Miami, FL - March 9, 2026 - The Miami Dolphins have officially moved on from quarterback Tua Tagovailoa, ending a six-year era that once carried franchise-altering promise. The Dolphins announced Monday that they are releasing Tagovailoa with a post–June 1 designation, closing the chapter on a tenure defined by flashes of brilliance, persistent injuries and rising questions about his long-term durability.
